findings: All eight frozen stages were attempted and independently accepted: four inverse/invariant/cocycle/norm construction families in each arm. Serial control succeeded four of four first attempt; guided succeeded three first attempt and one after repair.

Control used four logical/HTTP calls and 6279 reported tokens. Guided used five logical/HTTP calls and 12706 tokens. Every task pair used more guided inference; zero pairs met the frozen five-percent realized matching criterion. Identical ceilings did not create matched realized compute.

The guided inverse task had one AUTHORIZATION_OR_IR_REJECTION before independent acceptance. This is a source/binding/contract rejection, not a demonstrated false mathematical construction. The original sanitized attempt does not identify its exact offending syntax; do not invent that diagnosis or recover unnecessary raw output.

All nine model calls delivered with known usage: 18985 tokens, zero provider/capacity/truncation/JSON failures and zero unknown-usage calls. Native tool checking used 6890 work units and 16 ms; independent original-parse/grid verification used eight requests, 232 exact points and about 202 ms including process startup.

The independent oracle confirmed all 30 original obligations across the accepted candidates, with zero primary-positive/independent-negative discrepancies observed. This is limited to the observed constructions; planted negative tests, not these positives alone, validate detector behavior.

Fresh construction families extend the live composition evidence beyond prior interpolation/network parameter cases. They are classic bounded mathematics, not novel discoveries, general proof-search completion, official benchmark scores or superiority over an untooled model.

The result falsifies an acceptance/compute advantage for this obligation-guidance bundle on this corpus. Equal final acceptance with more inference cost and fewer first-attempt successes supports leaving the simpler serial path in use. One small epoch cannot establish a universal guidance disadvantage.

No default Ultra configuration, acceptance criterion, task, model profile, stage lease, source repository state or authority changed during the experiment. No tasks were rerun, no successes accumulated across epochs and no evaluator witness was supplied to the model.
assessment.nextGeneralIntervention: Keep obligation guidance experimental and unpromoted. Do not repeat exposed construction tasks or polish an emitter indefinitely. Use the verified simpler native/independent composition as the baseline for the goal's next prospective scientific investigation or genuinely strategy-requiring mathematical construction. Reuse existing research-party/prediction/experiment paths; first establish the missing general reasoning need and a faithful independent oracle on separate development work. Future causal promotion needs fresh more discriminating families, simpler untooled controls/ablations, matched realized compute and replication.
